row.evidence: Okta's CrowdStrike Falcon integration "leverages REST APIs to automate user lifecycle management", and is set up with a CrowdStrike API Client ID and Client Secret. No CrowdStrike SCIM endpoint is publicly documented.
row.notes: Status changed gated -> none (rule 3: provisioning without SCIM). The June row put SCIM on Falcon Enterprise. That claim matches a third-party SCIM summary, not a CrowdStrike source, so the plan gate is dropped. The only IdP provisioning found is Okta's OIN app. It connects with a Falcon API client (Client ID/Secret against api.crowdstrike.com) and pushes new users, profile updates and roles through CrowdStrike's REST user-management API (c4-c8). Okta's catalogue page still ticks 'SCIM' while describing a REST-API integration, and its supported-features list has no deactivation. Entra and JumpCloud are SAML SSO only: Entra says users must be created in Falcon before SSO. CrowdStrike's own product docs (falcon.crowdstrike.com/documentation) are behind a login, so SCIM absence could not be confirmed there, hence low confidence. Prices are per device, not per user. Falcon Go is now $59.99/device/year, up from $29.99 in June (c1). Pro is $99.99 and Enterprise $184.99, both unchanged. The public developer centre documents the user-management API (create, delete, update names, grant/revoke roles, reset 2FA/password).

scim.notes: null rather than false: no SCIM endpoint is documented publicly, and the Okta integration uses CrowdStrike's REST API with an API client.

auth.notes: OAuth2 client credentials from a Falcon API client; access tokens expire after 30 minutes. Regional base URLs exist (api.us-2, api.eu-1, api.laggar.gcw).

capabilities.notes: Update covers first and last name only. User actions are reset_2fa and reset_password.

okta.notes: OIN app ticks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update and Schema Discovery (last updated Jan. 8 2026), but provisioning is configured as an API integration with a Falcon API client. The supported features are push new users, push profile updates, import users and roles, and entitlement management. Deactivation is not listed.

fallbacks.notes: jit false per Microsoft's tutorial: users must exist in Falcon before SSO. docs_public false because CrowdStrike's product documentation requires a Falcon login. The API reference itself is public.

conflicts.text: Okta's catalogue page ticks SCIM for CrowdStrike Falcon but says the integration 'leverages REST APIs'; Okta's setup guide configures it with a CrowdStrike API Client ID and Secret, so the API description is used.

searched: web search: CrowdStrike Falcon SCIM provisioning (only third-party summaries)
open_questions: Whether CrowdStrike offers a SCIM endpoint inside the login-gated Falcon documentation is not verifiable publicly.
Which Falcon bundles include SAML SSO and API clients is not stated on the pricing page.
Whether deleting a user via the API (or Okta unassignment) revokes active Falcon console sessions is not documented publicly.
Audit-log API and user-event webhooks were not researched beyond the user-management collection.
